title: ACT ON SPECIAL CASES CONCERNING THE AFFIXING OR ATTACHMENT OF STAMPS AND PROVISION OF DEPOSITS
title_original: 인지 첩부·첨부 및 공탁 제공에 관한 특례법
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to prescribe special provisions concerning the affixing or attachment of stamps and the provision of deposits in litigation to which the State is a party and in administrative litigation, notwithstanding the Civil Procedure Act and the Act on the Stamps Attached for Civil Litigation, etc. <Amended by Act No. 11551, Dec. 18, 2012>
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 9807, Oct. 21, 2009]

Article 2 (Exemption from Affixing or Attachment of Stamps)
The State shall not affix stamps required under the Act on the Stamps Attached for Civil Litigation, etc. in proceedings for litigation to which it is a party or for administrative litigation.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 9807, Oct. 21, 2009]

Article 3 (Exemption from Providing Deposits)
When conducting litigation to which it is a party or administrative litigation, the State shall not provide a deposit under the Civil Procedure Act.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 9807, Oct. 21, 2009]

ADDENDUM <Act No. 832, Dec. 13, 1961>
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
This Act shall also apply to cases pending before courts at the time it enters into force; provided that it shall not affect stamps already affixed or deposits already provided.

ADDENDUM <Act No. 5454, Dec. 13, 1997>
This Act shall enter into force on January 1, 1998. (Proviso Omitted.)

ADDENDUM <Act No. 9807, Oct. 21, 2009>
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA <Act No. 11551, Dec. 18, 2012>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force one year after the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Amendments to Other Acts)
Paragraphs (1) through (3) omitted.
(4) The Act on Special Cases concerning Stamp Affixing and Deposit Offering is amended as follows:
The title "Act on Special Cases concerning Stamp Affixing and Deposit Offering" is changed to "Act on Special Cases concerning Stamp Affixing and Attachment and Deposit Offering".
In Article 1, "affixing (貼付)" is replaced by "affixing (貼付) and attachment (添附)".
In the heading of Article 2, "Exemption from Affixing" is replaced by "Exemption from Affixing or Attachment".
